full_judgment: 16. The burden of proof to invalidate a document lies upon the plaintiff. Moreover, on the basis of the registered deed, SA and R.S khatians were prepared in the names of the defendants. No two case are similar, every case has to be considered with its own facts and circumstances. The contentions of the learned Advocate for the petitioner is that in the instant case, the Holy Quran and the jainamaz are the consideration against the heba-bil-ewaz but it was not given to the executor of the deeds. The executor of the deeds in his life time did not say anything as to that effect that he was not given consideration i.e. the Holy Quran and the jainamaz. Since the executions of the deeds in question were not disputed, therefore, it is not essential to produce attesting witness. If the execution of a registered deed is denied by the executant then the same may be proved by an attesting witness or by producing the scribe of the deed in question or the person who knows the hand writing of the execution or by comparison of the disputed signatures with the admitted one and thumb impression or by producing thirty years old documents from a proper custody.
